original_attempt.correction: The original predicate required document width to equal innerWidth. The observed360px document fits the375px viewport; the difference is the vertical scrollbar. The corrected no-overflow predicate accepts document/body widths at or below viewport. App bytes were unchanged.
original_attempt.browser_followup_attempt: The first responsive follow-up timed out after its previously used browser reached the unchanged128-task job cap. That process and record were retained; the corrected responsive observations use a fresh browser.

scope: A local plaintext notebook uses the unchanged SCHISM public lifecycle. The listed observations establish their specific operations and platforms; the old and replacement operator records remain separately signed.
limits: Python 3.11+ is an application prerequisite, including with a native controller.
The service occupies numeric-loopback port 8787; use one Fieldnotes instance per host at a time.
Operator-managed plaintext files; no application encryption at rest or multi-user service.
Current notes survive compatible code rollback; content itself is not rolled back.
No macOS or unattended reboot qualification is claimed.
